_help: Boss sprites. mem/boss.mem is GENERATED from this file + the PNG strips.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_boss_mem.py
boss.mem: 3 bosses x 2 frames of 64x64. Source cells are 32x32 and are scaled EXACTLY 2x (each pixel -> 2x2, nearest neighbour).

scale: 2 = every pixel 2x2 (art sits where it is in the 32x32 cell), 3 = every pixel 3x3 and the art is centred in the 64x64 box (bosses look 1.5x bigger; the art must be at most 21x21 px, bigger art is cut).
Boss 1: frame 0 = normal, frame 1 = STUNNED picture (clap stun, W10). Boss 2 and 3: frame 0/1 = idle animation (boss 2 blinks while shielded).
frame = {"sheet": name, "col": n, "row": 1} (col from 0, row from 1). Missing/skipped/empty -> old art (mem/boss_v1.mem).
